{{Quote|It wasn't Ulic Qel-Droma's robe at all. It belonged to his Arkanian mentor, ''Arca Jeth''!"<br />"But-but legend says when Master Arca died, he vanished before Ulic's eyes..."<br />"-leaving nothing but the robe? I don't buy that-but it ''was'' Arca's robe! Ulic preserved it-a memento, I guess.|Rohlan Dyre and Zayne Carrick|<ref name="KOTOR 48">[[Knights of the Old Republic 48|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 48]]</ref>}}
A set of '''robes''' once belonged to [[Arca Jeth]], an [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who trained [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], and who died during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. After Jeth's [[Death/Legends|death]], the [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robe]] was taken by Qel-Droma, who always carried it with him. Wearing these robes bestowed an increase in wisdom upon the wearer, as well as an enhanced ability to refresh themselves within [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

Jeth's robe was stolen from Qel-Droma by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Demagol|Antos Wyrick]], who used genetic material found on the robe to raise [[Arkanian Offshoot/Legends|Offshoot]] children, enhanced with Jeth's genome and [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]]. While researching Demagol's background, the Mandalorian warrior [[Rohlan Dyre]] learned of the robe's history and its role in Wyrick's [[New Generation Project|project]], and later told the story to renegade [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Zayne Carrick]].<ref name="KOTOR 48" />
